means: Lids lowered to roughly half the iris - the drawn look of tiredness, boredom, or a lidded knowing gaze.
does: Lowers the eyelids and softens the stare. The catch is that this tag is genuinely ambiguous in the training data: the same lidded eye serves exhaustion, contempt, smugness and seduction, and on this checkpoint it drifts toward the sultry reading unless something else pins it down. Give it a companion or you will get a come-hither look on a beat about a man who cannot stand up - panting and sweat for exhaustion, a smirk for smugness, looking down for resignation. Seven of this project's twenty-seven emotion presets share this one tag, which is the ambiguity made visible.
reach_for_it: exhaustion, resignation, contempt and smugness - never on its own
used_in: the eyes field of emotions/exhausted, contempt, doubt, longing, resignation, smug and tender - seven presets, four different meanings
